title: Investment Opportunity In Cybersecurity Sector: Quantum Cybersecurity Center
summary: Government investment-opportunity sheet, hosted on the Oman National CERT site with an MTCIT contact address, inviting investors to set up a quantum cybersecurity centre in Muscat (estimated USD 20M total, 3 to 5 years to implement). It says quantum computers could break many current encryption protocols, which calls for a shift toward quantum-resistant and quantum-enhanced security. It names post-quantum cryptography and quantum cryptography (such as QKD) as the two approaches.
